notes.title: Dead's Dawn - Update 110424
notes.content:
Hello community, we are pleased to announce that we have applied several fixes in addition to adding a new system of notifying players when they connect to a server.

- The swimming system has been corrected, now you can only swim on the surface
- Vehicle impacts against enemies have been corrected
- From this moment on the chat will appear closed by default and can be opened with the key (T)
- An existing bug has been corrected when aiming repeatedly
- The item 'Money' has been added to the game, from now on missions and item spawn points can provide money that can be used in the game, the uses will be detailed in the next updates
- Changed the design of the HUD and the food and hydration icons
- Fixed character shooting accuracy for all targets
- Added a temporary free chamber on the (ALT) key
- Internal menu options have been reduced to correct problems when returning to the menu or exiting the game
- Problems that made it impossible to move the character once the chat and in-game menu were opened have been corrected
- Fixed the bug that did not allow jumping again after leaving a vehicle
- Fixed the bug that allowed jumping on top of enemies and other players
- Added a notification when a user enters a game
- Level system has been removed although the alpha missions will continue to give experience

[b]Known bugs for this version:[/b]
- Menú crashing

notes.title: Alpha Closed Playtest Announcement
notes.content:
Greetings colleagues, we are delighted to announce the start of the closed Alpha test of Dead's Dawn, which is scheduled to start on [b]April 13[/b] and will last for 24 hours until April 14. The valued members of the Discord community already have early access to this test, for the rest of the players we make available to you in your Steam profile the option to request access to the test.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2587500/Deads_dawn/

[b]Playtest objectives:[/b]
The main objective of this technical demo is to test the load and operation of the servers. We hope that with your participation we can obtain information that will help us continue developing and improving Dead's Dawn.

[b]What to expect from the Playtest?:[/b]
As this is a technical demo in Alpha you will find a map that will not be the final one of the game, there will only be spawn points for specific enemies and there will be no missions, objectives or advanced game mechanics, in conclusion we will include only what is necessary to be able to develop the tests of performance. We are also aware that there may be issues and unwanted gaming experiences that we regret and hope to analyze and correct in future updates.

[b]What to do during the Playtest?: [/b]
During the indicated days when you connect you will see official servers from different locations. Players are encouraged to connect to these servers and perform actions within the game as normal. We will collect information such as ping, connection speed and other parameters to analyze the operation of the multiplayer system. You can also take advantage of this opportunity to report any problem that arises, you can do so from the link indicated in Discord or from the internal game options menu.

During the development of the Playtest, the development team will remain active as long as possible to respond to specific problems and queries through the Discord channel.

If you like sandbox, survival or shooting games add this game to your wishlist and sign up for the closed trial. We invite all players to join our community and follow our networking channels for updates.

We greatly appreciate the support and help of all of you who are fully collaborating with the development of Dead's Dawn.

To learn more about Dead's Dawn please visit:
Official website: https://deadsdawn.com/
Discord Community: https://discord.com/invite/2wvdpvJqJd
Changelog and feedback: https://6561e1f4b47c7.sleekplan.app/
